title: ed-donner/llm_engineering packages an eight-week practical AI course
friendlyTitle: A free repository teaches practical LLM engineering
summary: llm_engineering is an MIT-licensed collection of notebooks and projects accompanying an eight-week course on building with language models, with about 7,600 GitHub stars at publication. It covers API-based applications, retrieval, fine-tuning, agents and production-oriented projects, alongside setup guides and community contributions.
friendlySummary: This popular course repository contains eight weeks of notebooks and projects about language-model apps, retrieval, fine-tuning and agents. It has about 7,600 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Learners can follow the repository as a project-based path from simple model calls to more complete AI products, using free or low-cost notebook environments where possible. Model names and APIs age quickly, so check current provider documentation and spending controls before running older exercises.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It offers a clear path for learning by building real projects. Check current model names, software versions and API costs before following each exercise.
